headline: SIX SCENES WORTH THE JOURNEY
dek: Lakes, villages, alpine roads and hiking
caption:
A mountain escape with friends where every day feels different. ⛰️

Start with a walk around turquoise Lago di Braies (or a rowing boat in season). Take a scenic drive across Passo Gardena. Wander the meadows and village paths around Val di Funes, then choose a proper hiking day: cable car from Ortisei and the Seceda ridge, or the classic circular route around Tre Cime.

For a quieter outing near Val Gardena, there's a signed trail from Selva through Plans de Frea towards a small chapel on the pass.

These stops are across different valleys; don't treat this as a one-day itinerary. Pick one or two bases and give the hikes their own days. Check lifts, trail conditions and seasonal lake/road access before booking.

Who would be in your Dolomites group chat? Save this for your next hiking escape. 🗺️

Photos: Finge Holden, Andrei R. Popescu, Alan Jiang, Pascal Debrunner & Luka Verč / Unsplash.
